headline: Contested Belt Sees Fresh Base Movement
war_summary: The latest returns show the contested belt growing livelier as the war’s quiet hours give way to renewed base movement. Gutter is the sharpest change since the last edition: ten events landed in two hours and 39 across the day, with holdings now six Warden, no Colonial, and one neutral base, compared with two Warden, four Colonial, and one neutral earlier. WeatheredExpanse also shifted, recording seven fresh events and 26 over 24 hours; its balance now stands at three Warden, two Colonial, and four neutral positions. PalantineBerm remains active, though its recent pace has eased, with one Warden and six Colonial bases. LinnMercy retains a mixed line of two Warden, eight Colonial, and one neutral base after 13 daily events. MarbanHollow remains unsettled at one Warden, five Colonial, and two neutral positions, while NevishLine has posted 19 daily events and holds seven Warden and one Colonial base. StlicanShelf has seen recent movement as well. Heavy fighting continues in CallahansPassage, but no base events are recorded there. No victor is declared.
